pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Berlin Defense, Rio de Janeiro Variation
pages.notes: Overview was generic and credited Black with a bishop pair not yet won; plan 1 routed a knight c3-d1-e3 from b1; plan 2 named a b7-knight not yet there. Rewritten around 6.Qe2 Nd6 7.Bxc6 bxc6 8.dxe5 Nb7. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Berlin Defense, Rio de Janeiro Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plans treated ...c5 as still to come, had the attacked d4-bishop controlling the centre, and rerouted a b7-knight already traded. Rewritten: Be3 is forced, Black frees with ...d6 or ...d5 and ...Bb7. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Berlin Defense, Rosenthal Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Ba4 'maintain the pin' (none exists with d7 in place); plan 2 had ...b5 with the bishop on b5 and claimed Black's structure is better after Bxc6. Rewritten, noting that 6.Ba4 b5 7.Bb3 d5 transposes to the Open Ruy Lopez. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Berlin Defense, Winawer Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 had c3 then Nc3 (same square); plan 3 rerouted a c3-knight still on b1. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open Berlin, 5...Be7 6.Qd2 Nd6 7.Bxc6 bxc6 8.dxe5 Nb7
pages.notes: Overview said White won the bishop pair (Black has it); plan 1's b3/Bb2 set-up replaced with the standard Nc3, rook and Nd4; plan 3 sent the knight to d7 (a pawn is there); plan 4 hit a d4-pawn that isn't there. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open Berlin, 5...Be7 6.Qe2
pages.notes: Overview said 6.Qe2 prepares the e-file and called the line Open Spanish (it attacks the e4-knight; 6...Nd6 is usual, 6...d5 a sideline); plan 2 had a nonsense ...cxd6; plans 3 and 4 referred to d6 exchanges and a c-file that don't arise. Rewritten (reviewer rejected 'has to retreat', fixed and re-accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open Berlin, 5.d4 Nd6 6.Bxc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 used an unplayable f4-f5 (the f3-knight blocks) and d5 control; plan 2 said ...c5 undoubles the pawns (it doesn't). Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open Berlin, 5.d4 Nd6 Queenswap, 9.Nc3 h6
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave White the bishop pair (Black has it) and nonsense knight routes; plan 2 moved a king from e7 (it is on d8). Rewritten with h3-g4, Rd1+ and Ne4; overview notes what ...h6 does. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open Berlin, 5.d4 Nd6 Queenswap, 9.Nc3 Ke8
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White expanding with a4-b4 for a queenside passed pawn (White's majority is on the kingside); overview said Black traded queens (White did). Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open Berlin, 5.d4 Nd6 Queenswap, 9.Nc3 Ke8 10.h3
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 gave White a queenside majority (it is the kingside) and plan 1 played h3-g4 with h3 already on the board. Fixed. British spelling.
